overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by withholding minutes of a September 2021 executive session, because the session's purpose was still ongoing when the complaint was filed; the complaint was closed as resolved after minutes were later posted and amended.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to provide minutes of a September 10, 2021 executive session about terminating the former town administrator's employment.
allegations.key_passage: we conclude—as we explained in email correspondence on November 16 and 18, 2021—that the purpose for the September 10, 2021, executive session was still ongoing at the time the Open Meeting Law complaint was filed, and the Board permissibly withheld the executive session meeting minutes.
